learning.title: Learning
learning.subtitle: Words and phrases worth coming back to.
learning.topicHint: Choose a language and name your topic. You can create several topics for the same language.
learning.topicsEmpty: Create your first topic: English, Spanish or another language. Save words and phrases inside it.
learning.topicMissing: This topic could not be found.
learning.entryHint: A word or phrase is enough. Add a translation and explanations later.
learning.explanationPlaceholder: Meaning of each part and fixed expressions
learning.nativeUsagePlaceholder: Natural wording, nuance or usage notes
learning.rulePlaceholder: Grammar, an idiom or a feature of the construction
learning.entriesEmptyHint: Save your first word or phrase. To add entries from an extension, create a token in settings.
learning.unfilledHint: Entry saved. Add a translation, example or rule when you have time.
learning.selectEntry: Select a word or phrase to open its details.
learning.checkFields: Check required fields and text length.
learning.saveError: Could not save. Check the fields and try again.
learning.loadError: Could not load data. Try refreshing the page.
learning.deleteTopicWarning: This topic and all its words and phrases will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
learning.extensionHint: Save words and phrases from an extension
learning.tokensHint: Create a separate token for an extension or another tool. Submitted words and phrases appear in the selected topic’s Inbox.
learning.tokenPlaceholder: For example, Chrome on my laptop
learning.captureHint: Submit words and phrases and check whether they were saved.
learning.read_writeHint: Add, view, edit and delete words and phrases.
learning.tokensEmptyHint: Create a token and paste it into your extension. Give each tool its own token.
learning.tokensRestriction: Tokens only grant access to Learning. Revoke each token separately.
learning.tokenOnce: Copy this token and save it in your extension. You can show and copy it again later from the token list.
learning.tokenLoadError: Could not load the token. Try again.
learning.tokenLegacy: Created before tokens could be viewed, so it can’t be shown. Create a new one to view and copy it here.
learning.copyError: Could not copy. Select the token and copy it manually.
learning.revokeWarning: Revoke “{name}”? The tool using this token will lose access.
learning.tokenTopicHint: The extension will only be able to add words to this topic — pick it once, no need to send it with every request.
learning.tokenNoTopics: Create a topic first — a token has to be scoped to one.
learning.tokenEndpointHint: Paste this URL into the extension together with the token. The topic is already baked into the token, so every token posts to the same endpoint.
learning.audioError: Could not play the audio. Try again.

account.sectionHint: One account, two ways in. Link the second so you never lose access.
account.emailSubtitle: A second way in — for when Telegram isn't available.
account.emailConflict: This email is already linked to another account

errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

account.deleteHint: Every topic, entry and token goes with it.
account.deleteConfirmHint: The data is erased in 30 days. Until then you can change your mind — just cancel it here.
account.deleteScheduledHint: Until then the app works as usual. Changed your mind? Cancel below.

chat.hint: Ask anything about this entry: how it's used, how it differs from similar ones, more examples.
chat.hintTeacher: Write in the language you're learning, about anything. I'll reply, then point out your mistakes and show how a native speaker would say it.
chat.clearFailed: Couldn't clear the chat. Please try again.
chat.failed: Couldn't get an answer. Please try again.
chat.unavailable: The AI agent isn't answering right now. Try again in a moment.
chat.busy: The previous answer is still being written.
chat.tooMany: Too many questions in a row. Wait a few seconds.
chat.budgetReached: This chat has reached its limit for now. It resets at {time}. Time to practice the phrase instead.
chat.dailyReached: You've used today's chat limit. It resets at {time}.
chat.budgetLow: {percent}% of this chat's limit is used.
chat.teacherSubtitle: Free conversation in the language you learn: the teacher leads the lesson and corrects your mistakes.
chat.noTopicsHint: The teacher speaks the language of a topic, so pick which language you study.
chat.needAgentHint: The chat runs on your own agent and is available for DeepSeek for now. Connect it in settings: pick a provider and paste the API key.
chat.welcomeHint: Write anything or pick a way to begin. The teacher will find your level.

beginner.title: I'm a beginner
beginner.message: I'm a beginner. Start a lesson with me from the very basics.

talk.title: Let's just chat
talk.message: Let's just chat about simple things, and you correct my mistakes.

check.title: Check my sentences
check.message: I'll write sentences in the language I'm learning, and you go through my mistakes.

grammar.title: Go through grammar
grammar.message: Explain one useful grammar rule and give me exercises for it.

chat.loadFailed: Couldn't load the chat. Try refreshing the page.
chat.clearDialogConfirm: Clear the chat? This dialog stays in the history, and your next message starts a new one.
chat.historyHint: Cleared dialogs are kept here. You can read them or delete them.
chat.historyEmpty: No saved dialogs yet. When you clear the chat, the current dialog shows up here.
chat.deleteDialogFailed: Couldn't delete the dialog. Try again.

triggers.title: Chat highlights
triggers.hint: Words the chat marks in the teacher's replies, saved to your account. A word followed by a colon at the start of a paragraph marks the whole paragraph; elsewhere only the word.
triggers.anyLabel: Any short label with a colon becomes a frame
triggers.dialogue: Show A: / B: lines as a dialogue

ai.sectionHint: The agent writes the translation and explanations for the words you save from the extension. Your key is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
ai.loadError: Couldn't load the agent settings. Reload the page.
ai.effortHint: How long the agent thinks before it answers. Higher is slower and costs more.
ai.thinkingHint: Answer straight away, or reason first. Deeper reasoning is slower and costs more.
ai.teacherHint: In the chat the agent speaks the language you're learning and checks your mistakes: it explains each one in your language and shows how a native speaker would say it. Off: it just answers your questions.

errors.choice: Pick an agent and a level

scan.title: Words from a photo
scan.hint: Take a photo of a page, sign, menu or screen — the words and phrases in the language you study are found on the server, no AI agent needed.
scan.nothing: No words or phrases in the language you study were found in the photo. Try a closer shot in good light.
scan.addFailed: Some items could not be added. Try again.
scan.added: {count, plural, one {# item added} other {# items added}}
scan.addedHint: They will show up in Inbox. If an AI agent is connected, it fills in the cards: translation, transcription, examples and rules.

errors.failed: Couldn't read the photo. Try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many photos in a row. Wait a moment.

scan.allKnown: Everything found in the photo is already in this topic.
scan.known: {count, plural, one {# more is already in this topic} other {# more are already in this topic}}

path.title: Teacher
path.subtitle: A test finds your level, the AI teacher builds the program, you work through it level by level.
path.deleteTeacherConfirm: Delete the {language} teacher? You can add it again at any time.
path.deleteTeacherWithProgram: Delete the {language} teacher? The running program is not lost: it goes to the history.
path.scaleProgram: What the program is made of
path.rulesSubtitle: English grammar rules with examples, common mistakes and links to related rules.
path.rulesClosed: The rule book opens when you have an English teacher who explains in Russian.
path.teachersSubtitle: Each language has its own teacher, program and level.
path.addTeacherHint: Pick the language you want to learn and the language everything is explained in.
path.placementIntro: Your AI agent writes the questions for you and decides your level: the test climbs from A1 upward until it chooses to stop. Wrong answers do not fail you — they shape the program. The test needs access to the agent.
path.startFailedHint: It needs access to the AI agent: check that it is connected in settings and the key works.
path.retakeHint: Take the test again: the agent writes new questions and confirms your level or finds a new one.

test.scaleLeft: {n, plural, one {<num>#</num> question} other {<num>#</num> questions}} left in this level
test.scalePagesLeft: Up to {n, plural, one {# more page} other {# more pages}} of 8 questions
test.scaleCaption: There are at most as many pages as levels. The test ends earlier as soon as the AI agent finds your level.
test.scaleDoneCaption: Mistakes aren't penalized: they shape your study program.
test.howPick: Pick an option in each question.
test.howConfirm: Press “Answer” under the question to lock it in.
test.howAccept: When all are answered, press “Accept answers” at the bottom.
test.placedHint: Now the teacher reads the test — the wrong answers above all — and writes your program.
test.buildingHint: The program is being built in the background. You can close the app: it finishes on its own and will be here when you come back.
test.analyzing: The teacher is writing the program…
test.finalPassedHint: Program completed. Take the test for the next level: it starts right there.
test.finalPassedTop: This is the top of the scale. Program completed.
test.finalFailedHint: The level needs a little more work — the program stays open, retake the final test when it feels solid.

topic.noSpeech: Nothing heard. Tap again and say the phrase.
topic.voiceFailed: The microphone or speech recognition is not available. Type the phrase as you said it.
topic.speakFallback: Type the phrase you would say
topic.exercisesComing: The exercises for this topic are still being written — they will show up here on their own.
topic.exercisesOnStart: The exercises will appear when you start a lesson.
topic.away: You are paused. The lesson clock keeps running: press Resume to get back to the exercises.

lesson.pausedNote: The lesson clock does not stop: a pause only marks that you stepped away.
lesson.result: Studied {minutes} min, answers: {attempts}, correct: {correct}. The result is saved.

chat.hint: The teacher knows this topic and its rule. Ask about it or pick a mode below.

dialogue.label: Dialogue
dialogue.prompt: Simulate a dialogue on the topic "{topic}". Start simple and correct my answers as we go.

natural.label: Like a native
natural.prompt: Teach me to build natural phrases on the topic "{topic}": how a native speaker would say it in real life.

pronounce.label: Pronunciation
pronounce.prompt: Help me pronounce the words of the topic "{topic}": explain by sounds where and how to place the tongue.

cards.label: Word cards
cards.prompt: Make a set of the 30 most useful words for the topic "{topic}" with an example sentence for each, for everyday speech.

quick.label: 5 minutes
quick.prompt: Give me three short 5-minute exercises on the topic "{topic}", one at a time, and check my answers.

survey.title: Tell us about yourself
survey.hint: The program is built around you. Everything is optional.
survey.goalPlaceholder: moving abroad, work, an exam, chatting…

practice.title: Practise this rule
practice.note: What you write here lives while you are on this page. Leave it and it is gone.
practice.examplesEmpty: Ask your agent for new sentences that show this rule. Each one can be discussed with the teacher.
practice.exercisesEmpty: Four short drills on this rule, like in English Grammar in Use: put the verb in the right form, choose, correct the mistake, make a question or a negative.

chat.hint: The teacher has this sentence and its rule in front of them. Ask why it is built this way, or pick a question below.

why.label: Why this way?
why.prompt: Explain why this sentence is built this way: what each part does and why this form is used here.

turn.label: Question and negative
turn.prompt: Turn this sentence into a question and into a negative, and explain what changes.

more.label: More like it
more.prompt: Give me three more sentences like this one, with a translation, in different situations.
